questions.question: If 9 # 3 = 6; 15 # 3 = 9; 60 # 4 = 32; then what is the value of 27 # 3 = ?
questions.questionHtml: If 9 # 3 = 6; 15 # 3 = 9; 60 # 4 = 32; then what is the value of 27 # 3 = ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed is that both the numbers are added and result is divided by 2

9 # 3 = 6

→ (9 + 3) ÷ 2 = 6

15 # 3 = 9

→ (15 + 3) ÷ 2 = 9

60 # 4 = 32

→ (60 + 4) ÷ 2 = 32

Similarly;

27 # 3 = ?

→ (27 + 3) ÷ 2 = 15

Hence, the correct answer is 15.

questions.question: Aarush's birthday is on Thursday 27 th April. On what day of the week will be Mitul's birthday in the same year if Mitul was born on 28 th September?
questions.questionHtml: Aarush's birthday is on Thursday 27<sup>th</sup> April. On what day of the week will be Mitul's birthday in the same year if Mitul was born on 28<sup>th</sup> September?
questions.solution:
27th April Thursday (Aarush’s birthday)

Number of days between 27th April and 28th September

= 3 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 28 → 154

Number of odd days = 154/7 → 0 (odd days)

Day on Mitul’s birthday = 28th September

→ Thursday + 0 = Thursday

Hence, Mitul’s birthday is on Thursday.

questions.question: If a 3 + b 3 = 341 and ab = 30, then what is the value of a + b?
questions.questionHtml: If a3 + b3 = 341 and ab = 30, then what is the value of a + b?
questions.solution:
We know that

a3 + b3 + 3ab (a + b) = (a + b) 3      ----(1)

Given that, a3 + b3 = 341 and ab = 30

So, putting these values in equation (1), we get

341 + 3 × 30 (a + b) = (a + b)3      ----(2)

Putting the value of (a + b) from options in equation (2), we get

341 + 90 × 1 = 13

⇒ 431 ≠ 1

So, a + b ≠ 1

Again, 341 + 90 × 9 = 93

⇒ 1151 ≠ 729

So, a + b ≠ 9

Again, 341 + 90 × 7 = 73

⇒ 971 ≠ 343

So, a + b ≠ l7

Again, 341 + 90 × 11 = 113

⇒ 1331 = 1331

∴ a + b = 11

questions.question: What is the reflection of the point (-4, 3) in the line x = -2?
questions.questionHtml: What is the reflection of the point (-4, 3) in the line x = -2?
questions.solution:
Reflection of any point on the same side of an axis is always 0 because its distance would be parallel to its previous position.

Here (-4, 3) is reflected at x = -2 so x coordinates will be 0 because reflection will not occur and

Reflection of any point on opposite axis will always be same in magnitude because distance is same from both the points horizontally.

Hence reflection of y = 3 at x = -2 point will be = 3

∴ Reflection of point (-4, 3) at x = -2 is (0, 3)

questions.question: If 1 shirt is offered free on purchase of 4 shirts, what is the effective discount (in %) on each shirt?
questions.questionHtml: If 1 shirt is offered free on purchase of 4 shirts, what is the effective discount (in %) on each shirt?
questions.solution:
Given:

1 shirt is free with every 4 shirts.

Calculation:

Suppose marked price of each shirt = Rs.100

Discount on 4 shirts = C.P of one shirt

Here we assume that C.P = M.P

Total Cost price of 4 shirts = 4 × 100 = Rs. 400

It means the buyer has got 5 shirts at the cost price of 4 shirts

So Discount = 500 - 400 = Rs.100

Discount % = Discount/M.P × 100 = \(\frac{{100}}{{500}} \times 100 = 20{\rm{\% }}\)

questions.question: What is the sum of the first 13 terms of an arithmetic progression if the 5th term is 1 and the 8th term is -17?
questions.questionHtml: What is the sum of the first 13 terms of an arithmetic progression if the 5th term is 1 and the 8th term is -17?
questions.solution:
We know that,

Nth term of an A.P = an = a + (n - 1) d

⇒ a5 = a + (5 - 1) d

⇒ a + 4d = 1     ----(i)

⇒ a8 = a + (8 - 1) d

⇒ a + 7d = -17     ----(ii)

Eq (ii) - Eq(i)

⇒ 3d = -18

⇒ d = -6

From eq i

a + 4 × (-6) = 1

⇒ a = 1 + 24

⇒ a = 25

So,

Sum of 13 terms of an AP is given by

Sn = n/2 × [2a + (n - 1) d]

⇒ 13/2 × [2 × 25 + (13 - 1) (-6)]

⇒ 13/2[50 - 72]

⇒ \(\frac{{13}}{2} \times \left( { - 22} \right)\)

⇒ -143

∴ Sum of first 13 terms of an A.P is -143

questions.question: ΔXYZ is similar to ΔPQR. If ratio of Perimeter of ΔXYZ and Perimeter of ΔPQR is 4 : 9 and if PQ = 27 cm, then what is the length of XY (in cm)?

Ratio of Perimeter of ΔXYZ and Perimeter of ΔPQR is 4 : 9

⇒ Length of XY = 4/9 × 27= 12 cm

∴ Length of XY is 12 cm

questions.question: A and B together do a job in 12 days and A could do the job in 20 days if he worked alone. How many days would B take to do the job if he worked alone?
questions.questionHtml: A and B together do a job in 12 days and A could do the job in 20 days if he worked alone. How many days would B take to do the job if he worked alone?
questions.solution:
Let the total work = 60 units

Efficiency of A + B = 60 / 12 = 5 units /day

Efficiency of A = 60 / 20 = 3 units /day

So, Efficiency of B = total efficiency of (A + B) - efficiency of A = 5 - 3 = 2 units/day

⇒ Total time taken by B alone = 60 / 2 = 30 days

∴ B take 30 days to do the work alone

questions.question: The average marks of 40 students in an examination were 34. It was later found that the marks of one student had been wrongly entered as 62 instead of 26. What is the correct average?
questions.questionHtml: The average marks of 40 students in an examination were 34. It was later found that the marks of one student had been wrongly entered as 62 instead of 26. What is the correct average?
questions.solution:
Given:

The average marks of 40 students in an examination were 34

Formula used:

Average = Sum of all the terms/Total number of terms

Calculation:

Sum of total marks of students in an examination = 40 × 34 = 1360

Sum of correct total marks of students in an examination = 40 × 34 = 1360 + 26 - 62 = 1324

Correct average = (1324)/40 = 33.1

∴ The Correct average is 33.1

questions.question: The ratio of present ages of P and Q is 7 : 9. Before 10 years the ratio of their ages was 5 : 7. What is Q's present age (in years)?
questions.questionHtml: The ratio of present ages of P and Q is 7 : 9. Before 10 years the ratio of their ages was 5 : 7. What is Q's present age (in years)?
questions.solution:
Let the present ages of P and Q be 7x and 9x respectively

According to the question,

(7x - 10) / (9x - 10) = 5/7

⇒ 7(7x - 10) = 5 (9x - 10)

⇒ 49x - 70 = 45x - 50

⇒ 20 = 4x

⇒ x = 5

Present age of Q = 9x = 9 × 5 = 45 years

∴ Present age of Q is 45 years

questions.question: Point A divides segment BC in the ratio 5 : 1. Co-ordinates of B are (6,-4) and C are (0, 8). What are the co-ordinates of point A?
questions.questionHtml: Point A divides segment BC in the ratio 5 : 1. Co-ordinates of B are (6,-4) and C are (0, 8). What are the co-ordinates of point A?
questions.solution:
Let the coordinates of point A be (x and y)

Coordinates of point B = (6, -4) as (x1, y1)

Coordinates of point C = (0, 8) as (x2, y2)

m1 ∶ m2 = 5 ∶ 1

We know that by section formula

x = (m1x2 + m2x1)/(m1 + m2), y = (m1y2 + m2y1)/(m1 + m2)

x = (5 × 0 + 1 × 6)/(5 +1) = 6/6 = 1

y = (5 × 8 + 1 ×(-4))/(5 +1) = (40 - 4)/6 = 36/6 = 6

∴ The coordinates of point A is (1, 6)

Confusion Points

  • You Emigrate from your home country while you Immigrate to another country. 

Important Points

  • Immigrate begins with the letter I. If you associate 'I' with “in,” you can easily remember that immigrate means to move into a different country. Emigrate begins with an E, so if you associate it with exit, you’ll remember that it means to leave your home country.

questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the idiom/phrase.

Beat a dead horse

options.text: Show extreme level of cruelty especially to animals.
options.html: Show extreme level of cruelty especially to animals.

options.text: Exploit someone to the point of killing him/her.
options.html: Exploit someone to the point of killing him/her.

options.text: To uselessly dwell on a subject far beyond its point of resolution.
options.html: To uselessly dwell on a subject far beyond its point of resolution.

options.text: To continue playing a game knowing very well that you are going to lose.
options.html: To continue playing a game knowing very well that you are going to lose.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 3.

'Beat a dead horse means to keep talking about a subject that has already been discussed or decided'.
